name: dsh-chrome-cdp
description: DSH plugin: registers a native `chrome_cdp` tool, an embedded `chrome-cdp` skill, and a routing prompt section, so every session can open, measure, and screenshot a real page with the machine's own Chrome over CDP — no Playwright, no Puppeteer, no asking the user for screenshots.

scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/cdp.js && node --check src/tool.js && node --check src/skill.js && node --check src/prompt.js

author: qujinting
